_what: Every distinct item the live ARGUS desk ever withheld, hand-audited on 2026-09-20: all six were false positives (withholding precision 0.00). Author handles removed; claim text kept verbatim because the characters in it (bidi isolates, ZWJ, all-caps retail prose) are the test.

items.audit_reason: U+2066 LEFT-TO-RIGHT ISOLATE and U+2069 POP DIRECTIONAL ISOLATE, inserted by Twitter's own client around the @elonmusk mention. Isolates cannot reorder rendered text the way an override can; nothing is hidden. Ordinary 2022 tweet about Musk selling TSLA.
